<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=My Name Is ...|id=A0082}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
First contact! We learn how to say “hello” and how to introduce ourselves. And I think this is also one of the very first podcasts of the LojbanPod team. At least Leo seems to feel a bit uncomfortable in front of the mic. Well, there is always a first time. The keyword is '''llamarse''' – to call oneself.
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0004|A0004: She's not Mexican]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0007|A0007: Where are you from?]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0072|A0072: Here is my card]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''¡Hola! ¿Cómo te llamas?'''
| Hi! What is your name?
| '''Me llamo Antonia. ¿Y tú?'''
| My name is Antonia. And you?
| '''Yo soy Roberto.'''
| I'm Roberto.
| '''Encantada.'''
| Nice to meet you.
| '''Mucho gusto.'''
| It's a pleasure.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''¡Hola! ¿Cómo te llamas?'''
| Hi! What is your name?
| '''Me llamo Antonia. ¿Y tú?'''
| My name is Antonia. And you?
| '''Yo soy Roberto.'''
| I'm Roberto.
| '''Encantada.'''
| Nice to meet you.
| '''Mucho gusto.'''
| It's a pleasure.
}}</includeonly>

{{SbcNewline}}{{SbcNewline}}<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| Hi! I'm Roberto. What's your name?
| '''¡Hola! Yo soy Roberto. ¿Cómo te llamas?'''
| Hi! My name is Antonia. And you?
| '''¡Hola! Me llamo Antonia. ¿Y tú?'''
| Roberto. My name is Roberto. It's a pleasure.
| '''Roberto. Me llamo Roberto. Mucho gusto.'''
| Nice to meet you. And what's your name?
| '''Encantada. ¿Y cómo te llamas?'''
| ROBERTO!
| '''¡ROBERTO!'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
